linningorchid980: On the way to R-F6, Dietrich Linningorchi tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Dietrich Linningorchi checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
A bullet went through Dietrich Linningorchi's sleeve at R-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Raptor of the Concord (@raptor2561).
Dietrich Linningorchi wore a fresh bandage at R-F6 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour.
